g.text: """Self-test the implementation against independent reference CRCs.
Returns True iff the generated CRC reproduces every embedded reference
Catalogue algorithms check four fixed inputs (the empty string,
"123456789", all 256 byte values, and a 1 KiB pattern); the two large inputs are
regenerated with a byte-at-a-time loop, so no big array is embedded. The
references come from two independent engines that had to agree.
Run once on your target toolchain -- it is the cheapest way to catch a
compiler / endianness / width mismatch before trusting the output.
